name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Apples and Bananas
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Apples and Bananas gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Apples and Bananas is a fan-favorite hybrid with a fruit-forward profile that lives up to the name. Expect sweet apple and ripe banana notes up front, layered with tropical fruit brightness and a smooth, subtly gassy-earthy finish. The effect lands balanced and easygoing — a relaxed, feel-good calm with a gentle mood lift that fits comfortably any time of day.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Apples and Bananas flavor — sweet apple and banana with tropical fruit and gas
Balanced hybrid effects — mellow and easygoing, great any time of day

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Apples and Bananas is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
